facts.text: I am looking for writing prompts to help with character development.
I started writing short stories again about three weeks ago.
I have been focusing on building my characters and world.
I am interested in the "What If" game for character development exercises.
I am interested in the Character's Diary or Journal exercise.
I want suggestions on how to structure the "What If" game and Character's Diary or Journal exercises.
I am considering whether to structure the exercises or just wing it.
I like experimenting with different outcomes in the "What If" game.
I want example "What If" prompts to help me get started.
I want scenarios for a character trying to uncover a hidden world within their own city.
I want to combine "What If" prompts to create a more complex scenario.
I want a scenario where my character receives a cryptic message that leads to a hidden entrance or portal.
In my scenario, when my character gets to the hidden entrance or portal, they are kidnapped by a group claiming to be from the hidden world.
I want to know how my character would react to being kidnapped by a group claiming to be from the hidden world.
I plan to write a scene where my character receives the cryptic message and decides to investigate.
I plan to write about how my character reacts to being kidnapped.
I plan to write about the interactions my character has with their captors.
I started writing short stories again about three weeks ago because I saw a writing prompt on social media.
The social media writing prompt asked users to write a story using only 50 words.
The 50-word prompt sparked my creativity and got me going again.
